goal: Add release-scoped read-only candidate projections and a bounded internal old/new shadow comparison for the sealed Phase 4B Gear and Community Releases without changing public readers or creating an active Manifest pointer.
userValue: The project can prove that one immutable release combination reproduces current trusted browse, Resolve and Profile behavior before any public cutover is possible.
nonGoals: No public gear browse, Resolver Authority Context, Profile or frontend reader cutover
No Season Manifest database row or active retail pointer creation, promotion or rollback
No release, staging, sync-state or public payload write
No scheduled release refresh service or timer
No public baseline, recommendation, DPS comparison, optimizer or BiS behavior
No Phase 5 SimC job or Worker
No dependency installation or unapproved local download

candidate Authority Context rows are constrained to one exact Gear Release ID
candidate Community rows must be validatedAgainst the same Gear Release ID
one bounded internal shadow orchestration compares transitional and release-scoped readers
Authority cache identity includes candidate Manifest revision and exact Gear Release ID
focused missing, tampered and mixed-release fail-closed tests plus 40-spec candidate shadow evidence
mustNotChange: zero active Manifest pointer and zero persisted candidate Manifest rows
current mutable staging tables and sync writers
active gear workbench and legacy endpoint compatibility
deploy async-sync default and existing timer ownership
evidenceRequired: every candidate content query uses the same Gear or Community Release ID
Community Release binding to the exact Gear Release is checked before projection
missing registry/content rows, hash mismatch and mixed IDs return Authority unavailable without staging fallback
no-pointer transitional requests remain byte/semantic compatible and do not enter the candidate reader
40-spec old/new winner, Intent, legality, provenance, baseline and browse identity comparison
candidate Resolve and representative canonical Profile Dependency Vector comparison
cold/warm statement count, p95, cache size and bounded query-plan evidence
backend/full verification, local CR, exact-head CI, candidate deployment, zero pointer/public change and rollback evidence

engineeringHealth.reason: Slice 4C extends the single release SQL owner and adds explicit read-only adapters. It may run old/new readers internally but cannot conditionally splice release predicates across existing staging SQL or activate a public reader.

acceptanceEvidence: focused release-store, loader, read-model, runtime and shadow tests
Python compile, SQL/write-path inspection and git diff --check
candidate 40-spec shadow, missing/mixed-release failures, zero Manifest/Pointer/public change, health/timer/log and rollback proof

decisionLog.decision: Keep all immutable release SQL in gear_release_store.py; candidate adapters consume repository projections instead of adding release SQL to existing hotspot stores.
Use the sealed inactive Gear/Community pair as an explicit candidate binding; do not persist a Manifest or Pointer during shadow-reader implementation.
Run release-scoped projections only through an internal shadow path. Public routes continue transitional reads until a separate Phase 4D atomic cutover.
Treat the Phase 4B one-time import resource result as historical operator evidence, not as the performance budget for candidate readers or future scheduled refresh.
